instruction:
You are a process and energy resilience engineer checking a task-owned synthetic SSC-17 wastewater energy island package.

Use only the task-owned synthetic source pack values shown below for numeric grading. Process modelling, biogas, and BESS workflows shape the context only: this instance does not run external software or a real source-pack parser.

## Scene

- Product: `SSC-17-LH-02`
- Influent/effluent sample table: `WWTP-SSC17-002`
- PFD/process basis: `PFD-SSC17-002`
- Blower/motor schedule: `BLOWER-SSC17-002`
- Biogas/sludge record: `BIOGAS-SSC17-002`
- PV/BESS/feeder schedule: `BESS-SSC17-002`
- Critical-process resilience memo: `MEMO-SSC17-002`

## Source Values

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Influent flow | {{ influent_flow_mld }} ML/d |
| BOD | {{ bod_mg_l }} mg/L |
| Ammonia | {{ ammonia_mg_l }} mg/L |
| BOD oxygen factor | {{ bod_oxygen_factor }} kg O2/kg BOD |
| Nitrification oxygen factor | {{ nitrification_oxygen_factor }} kg O2/kg N |
| Blower specific energy | {{ blower_specific_energy_kwh_kg_o2 }} kWh/kg O2 |
| Auxiliary critical load | {{ auxiliary_critical_load_kw }} kW |
| Outage duration | {{ outage_duration_hr }} h |
| Volatile solids | {{ volatile_solids_kg_d }} kg/d |
| Biogas yield | {{ biogas_yield_m3_kg_vs }} m3/kg VS |
| Methane fraction | {{ methane_fraction }} |
| Methane energy | {{ methane_energy_kwh_m3 }} kWh/m3 |
| CHP efficiency | {{ chp_efficiency }} |
| BESS nominal energy | {{ bess_nominal_kwh }} kWh |
| Maximum depth of discharge | {{ max_depth_of_discharge }} |
| Inverter efficiency | {{ inverter_efficiency }} |

## Output Format

Write a compact memo to `/workspace/output.md`. Include a source-boundary statement that this is a task-owned synthetic source pack. Preserve the source IDs above and state whether the baseline source pack passes the current docs-only checks.

Do not claim authority approval, accepted project evidence, software export validity, full standards compliance, executable real source-pack parsing, generated benchmark readiness, or benchmark readiness.

Include a fenced JSON block with exactly these numeric keys:

```json
{
  "oxygen_demand_kg_d": <numeric_value>,
  "blower_energy_kwh_d": <numeric_value>,
  "blower_average_kw": <numeric_value>,
  "biogas_production_m3_d": <numeric_value>,
  "chp_energy_available_kwh": <numeric_value>,
  "bess_usable_energy_kwh": <numeric_value>,
  "critical_process_energy_kwh": <numeric_value>,
  "resilience_energy_available_kwh": <numeric_value>,
  "energy_margin_kwh": <numeric_value>,
  "battery_only_runtime_hr": <numeric_value>,
  "overall_pass_score": <numeric_value>
}
```
paramsToml:
[meta]
name = "wastewater-energy-island-resilience-package"
description = "SSC-17 wastewater process energy island resilience metrics"
long_description = "Calculates source-bound wastewater energy island metrics from a deterministic SSC-17 task-owned source pack. The template combines oxygen demand, blower energy, biogas CHP, BESS autonomy, critical-process energy, and an overall synthetic pass score."
discipline = "mechanical"
category = "wastewater-energy-resilience"
standards = ["wastewater process energy workflows", "biogas CHP workflows", "BESS dispatch workflows"]
tags = ["mechanical", "wastewater", "biogas", "blower", "bess", "resilience", "energy", "deterministic"]
tool_mode = "with-tool"

[params.influent_flow_mld]
type = "float"
unit = "ML/d"
description = "WWTP-SSC17-002 influent flow"
min = 2.4
max = 2.4

[params.bod_mg_l]
type = "float"
unit = "mg/L"
description = "WWTP-SSC17-002 influent BOD"
min = 220.0
max = 220.0

[params.ammonia_mg_l]
type = "float"
unit = "mg/L"
description = "WWTP-SSC17-002 influent ammonia"
min = 32.0
max = 32.0

[params.bod_oxygen_factor]
type = "float"
description = "PFD-SSC17-002 BOD oxygen factor"
min = 1.1
max = 1.1

[params.nitrification_oxygen_factor]
type = "float"
description = "PFD-SSC17-002 nitrification oxygen factor"
min = 4.57
max = 4.57

[params.blower_specific_energy_kwh_kg_o2]
type = "float"
unit = "kWh/kg O2"
description = "BLOWER-SSC17-002 blower specific energy"
min = 0.75
max = 0.75

[params.auxiliary_critical_load_kw]
type = "float"
unit = "kW"
description = "BLOWER-SSC17-002 auxiliary critical load"
min = 18.0
max = 18.0

[params.outage_duration_hr]
type = "float"
unit = "h"
description = "MEMO-SSC17-002 critical process outage duration"
min = 12.0
max = 12.0

[params.volatile_solids_kg_d]
type = "float"
unit = "kg/d"
description = "BIOGAS-SSC17-002 volatile solids"
min = 520.0
max = 520.0

[params.biogas_yield_m3_kg_vs]
type = "float"
unit = "m3/kg VS"
description = "BIOGAS-SSC17-002 biogas yield"
min = 0.68
max = 0.68

[params.methane_fraction]
type = "float"
description = "BIOGAS-SSC17-002 methane fraction"
min = 0.62
max = 0.62

[params.methane_energy_kwh_m3]
type = "float"
unit = "kWh/m3"
description = "BIOGAS-SSC17-002 methane energy content"
min = 9.97
max = 9.97

[params.chp_efficiency]
type = "float"
description = "BIOGAS-SSC17-002 CHP electrical efficiency"
min = 0.34
max = 0.34

[params.bess_nominal_kwh]
type = "float"
unit = "kWh"
description = "BESS-SSC17-002 nominal energy"
min = 300.0
max = 300.0

[params.max_depth_of_discharge]
type = "float"
description = "BESS-SSC17-002 maximum depth of discharge"
min = 0.8
max = 0.8

[params.inverter_efficiency]
type = "float"
description = "BESS-SSC17-002 inverter efficiency"
min = 0.92
max = 0.92

[outputs.oxygen_demand_kg_d]
description = "Total process oxygen demand"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.blower_energy_kwh_d]
description = "Daily blower energy"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.blower_average_kw]
description = "Average blower power"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.biogas_production_m3_d]
description = "Daily biogas production"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.chp_energy_available_kwh]
description = "CHP energy available during the outage window"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.bess_usable_energy_kwh]
description = "Usable BESS energy"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.critical_process_energy_kwh]
description = "Blower plus auxiliary energy required during outage"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.resilience_energy_available_kwh]
description = "CHP plus BESS energy available"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.energy_margin_kwh]
description = "Available resilience energy minus required process energy"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.battery_only_runtime_hr]
description = "Battery-only runtime at blower plus auxiliary load"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.overall_pass_score]
description = "1.0 when energy margin is non-negative"
tolerance = 0.001

[archetypes.ssc17_wastewater_energy_island_case]
description = "Wastewater process energy island case with oxygen demand, biogas CHP, and BESS autonomy"

site_contexts = ["wastewater-energy-island-resilience", "process-biogas-bess-autonomy-check"]
